S.meaning: bundle subject: a PN, a record id such as a stack-up (STK-101), a subassembly, check or case id, or assembly for the whole product

VIEW.meaning: render or capture view name; per-part views carry the PN

SCENE_SHA.meaning: sha256 of the concept scene file

CAPTURE_SHA.meaning: sha256 of the captured viewer state

SHA.meaning: sha256 of a stored part output's bytes, or of the inputs of a cached part output

PID.meaning: process id of the writing run

STAMP.meaning: monotonic clock stamp of the writing run

RUN.meaning: id of one supervised sweep, check or FEA run

kind.record: authored source the lead controls; the design is defined here
kind.generated: written by the named command from the record; never edited by hand
kind.scratch: drafts and staging beside hw/; never record evidence

mutability.controlled: changed through the record workflow; after design_freeze only by an approved change (flow.change)
mutability.regenerated: rewritten by its writer whenever its inputs change
mutability.append_only: add or supersede; never rewrite an approval
mutability.free: edited freely; earns no geometry, check or release credit
mutability.immutable: sealed once written; a changed input makes a new version or, with --replace, a new bundle
mutability.pointer: repointed by its writer to the newest complete version; not an approval
mutability.scratch: disposable work space; nothing in it counts until published

role.manufacture: final geometry in its manufacturing state
role.manifest: the inventory that seals its directory
role.snapshot: copy of a record file at build or release time

one part output is stored read-only under the sha256 of its bytes. Outputs include definition or state STEP, manufacturing STEP, STL, and manufacturing.json. The output is git-ignored and is not evidence. cad_model.py store gc removes it once no manifest references it

rules.message: {PATH} is a scratch tree inside hw/
rules.action: Scratch lives in the project's .cad-work/ beside hw/, never inside it. Move the tree there; nothing in it counts as record evidence. Nothing was changed.

rules.message: {PATH} is an unversioned drawing with unverified provenance
rules.action: Regenerate the drawing with cad-drawings for a built version, or migrate it explicitly with its provenance; never guess the version from file dates. Nothing was changed.

rules.message: {PATH} is a render from before subject bundles
rules.action: Renders are one sealed bundle per version and subject. Re-render the version with cad-render, then delete this flat set after review. Nothing was changed.

rules.message: {PATH} is a capture from before subject bundles
rules.action: Captures are one sealed bundle per version and subject. Capture again with cad-viewer, then delete this flat set after review. Nothing was changed.

rules.message: {PATH} is a concept screenshot from before preview bundles
rules.action: Concept previews are bundles bound to their scene and state. Take the screenshot again with cad-concept serve.py, then delete this one after review. Nothing was changed.

rules.message: {PATH} is procurement evidence for {PN} outside its sources/ folder
rules.action: Move the file to hw/parts/{PN}/sources/ and update procurement/specification/artifact in hw/parts/{PN}/part.yaml; its sha256 is unchanged. Nothing was changed.

classes.message: {PATH} is not a managed CAD output
classes.action: Geometry is generated, never placed by hand. Define the state in hw/parts/{PN}/model.py; cad-model run writes hw/versions/{NEXT}/manufacturing/{PN}/part.step, and part.stl for an FDM part. Keep any one-off exporter outside hw/, for example in .cad-work/migration/. Nothing was changed.
hw/parts/<PN>/model.py is the only CAD source in hw/. Fold the behaviour into the part's model.py, or keep the script outside hw/, for example in .cad-work/migration/. Nothing was changed.
Move human notes and reference material to hw/docs/; nothing there earns geometry, check or release credit. Nothing was changed.

classes.message: {PATH} is not a managed CAD path
classes.action: If a CAD command produced it, run that command again so the output lands in its bundle; otherwise keep it outside hw/, for example in .cad-work/migration/. Nothing was changed.

layout.stray.meaning: a path no layout entry, exception or rule accepts; its class says where it belongs

layout.misplaced.meaning: a recognised file in the wrong place

layout.legacy.meaning: an output from an older layout; regenerate it

layout.foreign.meaning: a file inside a bundle or version directory that its entry does not hold
layout.foreign.message: {PATH} is not a file a {ENTRY} directory holds
layout.foreign.action: {DIR} holds only {FILES}; {WRITER} writes it. Run it again, then remove this file after review. Nothing was changed.

layout.empty_directory.meaning: an empty directory no layout entry names
layout.empty_directory.message: {PATH} is an empty directory outside the CAD layout
layout.empty_directory.action: Remove the empty directory; nothing in the layout lives there. Nothing was changed.

layout.transient.meaning: a leftover from an interrupted writer

layout.symlink.meaning: a symlink to a path inside hw/; managed paths are real files
layout.symlink.action: Replace the link with the file it names, or remove it; managed paths are real files. Nothing was changed.

layout.unsealed.meaning: a bundle or version directory without its manifest.json
layout.unsealed.message: {PATH} has no manifest.json, so nothing seals its contents
layout.unsealed.action: Only {WRITER} seals {DIR}. Run it again so it writes a complete directory, then remove this one after review. Nothing was changed.

layout.unsafe_path.meaning: a name with control characters, backslashes, undecodable bytes or edge whitespace, or a special file
layout.unsafe_path.message: {PATH} has an unsafe name or is not a regular file or directory
layout.unsafe_path.action: Rename it to a plain printable name, or remove it. Nothing was changed.

layout.symlink_escape.meaning: a symlink that resolves outside hw/
layout.symlink_escape.message: {PATH} is a symlink to {TARGET}, outside hw/
layout.symlink_escape.action: Replace the link with a copy of the file inside hw/, or remove it; the record must not depend on files outside hw/. Nothing was changed.

layout.unlisted.meaning: a file inside a sealed directory that its manifest does not list
layout.unlisted.message: {PATH} is not in {DIR}/manifest.json; the sealed directory gained a file
layout.unlisted.action: A sealed directory never gains files. Remove this file, or produce a new version or bundle that writes it. Nothing was changed.

layout.missing.meaning: a file a sealed manifest lists that is absent
layout.missing.action: The sealed payload is incomplete. Restore the file from version control, or produce a new version or bundle. Nothing was changed.

layout.malformed_manifest.meaning: a sealing manifest that cannot be read, or that names another place or build
layout.malformed_manifest.action: Restore manifest.json from version control, or produce the directory again with {WRITER}. Nothing was changed.
